title: Captcha required
description: {host} wants a captcha solved before this download can continue.
answer_description: Type the characters shown in the image.
queued: One more captcha is waiting. | {count} more captchas are waiting.

click.description: Click the spot in the image the prompt asks for. Clicking again moves the mark; nothing is sent until you press the button.
click.surface: Captcha image: click or use the arrow keys to mark a spot, Enter sends it
click.keyboard: Keyboard: the arrow keys move the mark by one pixel, with Shift by ten; Enter sends it.

widget.title: {kind} is answered on the hoster's own page
widget.description: {host} protects this download with {kind}. The widget is tied to the hoster's own domain and cannot be shown here at all. Answer it in your own browser: the rDownloader browser extension opens the hoster's page in a tab and hands the answer back — a solver service answers it without you.
widget.extension_connected: The browser extension is connected: it announces this captcha and opens {host} in a tab of your browser.
widget.extension_missing: No browser extension is connected, and without one only a solver service can answer this captcha. Install and pair the extension to answer it yourself, in your own browser.
widget.hint: Connect the browser extension and answer the captcha in the tab it opens, set up a solver service in the network settings, or decline this captcha and let the download fail. There is no other way: a widget is bound to the hoster's own domain, so neither this interface nor the desktop agent can show it.

settings.title: Captchas
settings.description: Free downloads without an account often require a captcha. rDownloader can pass it to a solver service, or ask you directly.

solver.label: Solver service
solver.description: A service with a 2captcha-compatible API answers captchas automatically.

endpoint.label: API endpoint
endpoint.description: Absolute https URL of the service; empty keeps the stored endpoint.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Stored encrypted and never returned by the API.
api_key.stored: A key is stored. Enter a new one to replace it.

manual.label: Ask me for image captchas
manual.description: Image captchas appear as a prompt in the web interface.

timeout.label: Answer timeout
timeout.description: How long a captcha waits for your answer before the download fails.

settings.hint: Widget captchas (reCAPTCHA v2, hCaptcha, Turnstile) are bound to the hoster's domain and cannot be shown here. They are answered either by a solver service or by you — in your own browser through the rDownloader browser extension, which opens the hoster's page in a tab. That extension is the only way a person answers one; the desktop agent does not show them. Manual solving in this interface covers image captchas only. Changes are saved with the configuration.
